# Thalux AI — Digital Infrastructure for Trade Shops

> Thalux AI builds, manages, and maintains the digital infrastructure for trade shops (auto repair, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, contracting). Month-to-month, no contracts.

## Services

- **Website Management** — Custom multi-page websites with AI voice receptionist integration, mobile responsive, SEO-optimized. From $299/mo.
- **Google Business Profile Optimization** — Claim, optimize, and manage GBP. Photos, posts, review management, Q&A. Included in all plans.
- **Facebook Marketing** — Page setup, content calendar, local ad management. Included in all plans.
- **AI Voice Receptionist** — 24/7 AI-powered phone answering. Captures every lead via SMS. Custom greeting and routing. $195/mo per line.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Includes |
|------|-------|----------|
| Bronze | $299/mo | Website + GBP + Facebook |
| Silver | $399/mo | 3-page website + GBP + Facebook (most popular) |
| Gold | $499/mo | 5-page website + GBP + Facebook (full package) |
| AI Receptionist | $195/mo | Add-on per line |

Free setup on all plans. Month-to-month, no long-term contracts.
